scenes.big: Can high BP hurt your eyes?
scenes.say: Can high blood pressure hurt your eyes? Yes, it can. Here's how.

scenes.en: The retina at the back of your eye is fed by very fine blood vessels.
scenes.ta: கண்ணின் பின்புறம் நுண்ணிய ரத்த நாளங்கள் உள்ளன
scenes.say: The retina, at the back of your eye, is fed by very fine blood vessels.

scenes.en: Over years, uncontrolled BP can narrow, leak or even block them.
scenes.say: Over the years, uncontrolled blood pressure can narrow these vessels, make them leak, or even block them.

scenes.en: Blurred vision may come late. Don't wait for it.
scenes.say: Often there are no early signs. Your sight may turn blurry only later, so don't wait for it.

scenes.en: Keep BP in check as your doctor advises, and get a yearly eye check.
scenes.ta: BP-ஐ கட்டுப்பாட்டில் வையுங்கள், வருடம் ஒருமுறை கண் பரிசோதனை
scenes.say: Keep your BP in check as your doctor advises, and get your eyes checked every year.

scenes.en: See an eye specialist right away. Get an eye test.
scenes.ta: திடீரென பார்வை மங்கலா? உடனே கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: If your vision suddenly changes, see an eye specialist right away. And book your eye test today.
